title: Replace recency-only task selection with multi-signal relevance ranking
context: Previous approach selected 3 most recent tasks on a file. Missed relevant history that didn't happen to be recent. Agents need better context to avoid redoing verified work. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.); con_03a0b94b2e (The agent hook must never block an edit on failure: any error exits 0 and never denies; after the event is recognized it emits at most one 'grounding unavailable' context line, unrecognized input emits nothing); con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_91e6074b66 (Capability pages for functionality shipped in the current release must state that it ships today and must not retain the stale banner 'In development for the next release.'); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Implement deterministic ranking: gate candidates by structure (same file, dependencies, co-change from git history, shared rules); score on 6 dimensions (file relation, IDF-weighted shared records, outcome violations, phrase match, recency with 30-day half-life, working-set overlap); slot results as latest-on-file + most-recent-problem + relevant with MMR deduplication; explain each selection with top 2 reasons.
consequences: Agents see task history selected for relevance, not recency alone
All selections deterministic and replayable via cached git history
Each task line shows factual reasons ('same file', 'shares con_x', 'RULE VIOLATED', '12 days ago')
Pre-edit hook cost increases (git history parsing, multi-factor scoring)
System now aware of outcomes (violated rules rank highest), dependencies, and co-change patterns
alternatives_rejected: Keep three-most-recent (ignores relevance, misses better context)
Vector embeddings for similarity (non-deterministic, LLM-dependent, not git-grounded)
Simple keyword/phrase match (no structural awareness, high false positives)
Include all historical tasks (noise >> signal, budget-breaking)
